prompt: The game's own 6x10 monospaced bitmap font — 104 glyphs on a 32-column grid — authored from the master palette by art/tools/make-ui-font.mjs. §15 puts text-in-sprites on the NEVER list and names a runtime bitmap font as the only sanctioned way to draw text, and says in the same breath not to ask an image model for letterforms. Monospaced on purpose: every site it replaces asked the browser for `ui-monospace`, and a fixed advance means the font publishes NO per-glyph metrics — a cell is index%%32 across and index/32 down, which is the same arithmetic on both sides. Column 5 and row 9 of every cell are an advance gutter so nearest-neighbour sampling at a seam picks up transparency rather than the next letter; the em dash is the one glyph allowed to use all six columns, because that is what an em dash is. Drawn in `paper`, the palette's declared UI-text-on-dark value, and tinted at draw time. `trim` is false — trimming a glyph grid to its overall bounds would slide every cell off the grid, the same reason the crop strips opt out.
